project: 沙县熟客与加绒鞋短剧

continuity.scene: same neighborhood snack restaurant, same night and meal
continuity.axis: man screen-left facing right, owner screen-right facing left; same camera half-space
continuity.old_shoes: ordinary dark old shoes; not this product and not a named competitor
continuity.new_shoes: ZX9507 black knit slip-on, beige sculpted outsole; no laces or heel loop
continuity.shoe_states: S01-S08 old shoes; S09 visibly elides change; S10-S15 new shoes
continuity.product_boundary: unseen lining requires real same-variant reference; no generated performance demonstration

production_groups.purpose: elliptical shoe change and quiet response
next visit and decision to stay

shots.action: Man lifts curtain and enters; owner wipes counter at rear right.
Owner continues wiping, avoids looking at him; his shoulder only anchors space.
He pauses, accepts the rebuff and sits in his usual chair.
After an implied preparation interval, food is on table. She places the bag on adjacent empty stool.
He looks down at the bag and touches its opening; cut before a complex unboxing.

shots.framing: supported open box and shoes close-up
shots.action: Box is already open and supported on lap. He lightly touches collar; show only verified shoe surfaces.

dialogue.speaker: owner
dialogue.text: 夜里穿，别老穿那双薄的。

shots.requires: same-variant lining reference if lining is exposed in detail
shots.fallback: verified upper and side angle without invented lining

shots.action: He looks from shoes to owner before a faint smile.
She tidies the same chopstick holder to avoid eye contact.

shots.framing: two inserts separated by clear elliptical cut
shots.action: He settles box beside him and reaches towards shoes; cut to new pair already on feet, hand straightens one heel collar.
shots.constraint: not a continuous morph or hands-free entry; old shoes go in bag

shots.action: He settles his posture and smiles down quietly after fixing heel.
He takes out phone; bag holds old shoes. She wipes at right, keeping same axis.
shots.constraint: no readable payment UI or actual transaction

shots.action: He waits with phone held still, looking at her.
Her hand stops for half a beat then resumes wiping; voice softens slightly.
New pair visible. One foot pointing toward exit turns back and slides under table; phone settles audibly above frame.
shots.constraint: natural small foot motion and grounded feet; preserve outsole shape

shots.action: A small pickle dish slides from her side to his hand beside the meal; her hand withdraws, hold the result.

next_step: Review script, make continuous readthrough and seven key compositions; select model/provider before exact executable prompts or paid generation.
